description: Full SwiftUI macOS agent with design, architecture, and verification
scaffold_command: brew list xcodegen &>/dev/null || brew install xcodegen && mkdir -p {app_dir}/Sources {app_dir}/Tests {app_dir}/UITests {app_dir}/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset {app_dir}/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AccentColor.colorset
build_command: cd {app_dir} && xcodegen generate 2>/dev/null; SCHEME=$(xcodebuild -list -json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["project"]["schemes"][0])' 2>/dev/null || echo '{app_name}'); xcodebuild -project *.xcodeproj -scheme "$SCHEME" -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ./build build 2>&1
prompt_addendum: IMPORTANT: Build this as a **SwiftUI macOS** app (not iOS, not UIKit, not Electron). Use Swift, SwiftUI, and AppKit where needed. Use XcodeGen with a project.yml for project setup — do NOT create .xcodeproj manually. Target macOS 14.0+. Use @Observable (not ObservableObject). Name the project '{app_name}'. Create the project in: {app_dir}
